content:
I think `randao_reveal` in the JSON block body should be an array of 32 roots and not a single long hex string.

Aka
```
  "randao_reveal": [
    "0x5e73e469fc545e64324d332af054a3b7dea266cdd8780d62f8188cfec9ba94fc",
    "0x88a27f100603a92e07bbd862d75953fa73e3e126655fa2e0073f6c621102e312",
    "0xd5e000f791f69a46231d2b3c3d1b4e16ddcdf23c7ce583ce0d8172916af5856f",
    …
    "0xa71dfe48d6b1c91d316ffb9429647ce4a3b71d572ed761f55320ac3f09bfffda",
    "0x5742c372095afa5ed48ac5c2ed86866f0345fec21bb5ec776f009c0993d0d0bb"
  ]
```

instead of 

```
  "randao_reveal": "0x5e73e469fc545e64324d332af054a3b7dea266cdd8780d62f8188cfec9ba94fc88a27f100603a92e07bbd862d75953fa73e3e126655fa2e0073f6c621102e312d5e000f791f69a46231d2b3c3d1b4e16ddcdf23c7ce583ce0d8172916af5856f…5742c372095afa5ed48
  ac5c2ed86866f0345fec21bb5ec776f009c0993d0d0bb"
```

In my previous example, `randao_reveal[0]` is the leaf, and `randao_reveal[1]` to `randao_reveal[31]` the path of the proof.

We already have this shape with `kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof`:

```
    "kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof": [
      "0x2c4fb2b4a1f6d3e8c0a9b7e5d3c1f0e2a4b6c8d0e2f4a6b8c0d2e4f6a8b0c2d4",
      "0x9e1d3c5b7a9f8e6d4c2b0a1f3e5d7c9b1a3f5e7d9c1b3a5f7e9d1c3b5a7f9e1d",
      "0x4a6c8e0f2b4d6f8a1c3e5b7d9f0a2c4e6b8d0f1a3c5e7b9d0f2a4c6e8b0d1f3a",
      "0x7b9d1f3a5c7e9b0d2f4a6c8e1b3d5f7a9c0e2b4d6f8a0c1e3b5d7f9a1c2e4b6d"
    ]
```
